title: Wall St retreats as hot inflation data fuels rate worries
en: US stocks fell on Tuesday as a hotter-than-expected inflation reading cemented expectations for a rate hike from the Federal Reserve next month. The Labor Department said the Consumer Price Index increased 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% estimate, after advancing 0.6% in September. Core CPI rose 0.3%, also topping forecasts. The Dow closed down 0.30%, the S&P 500 fell 0.38%, and the Nasdaq lost 0.74%. Markets are now fully pricing in a rate hike of at least 25 basis points in December, and the two-year Treasury yield surged as bonds were sold off.
zh: 美国股市周二下跌，因高于预期的通胀数据巩固了市场对美联储下月加息的预期。劳工部称，10月消费者价格指数（CPI）环比上涨0.4%，高于0.3%的预期，此前9月为上涨0.6%；核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同样超出预期。道指收跌0.30%，标普500跌0.38%，纳指跌0.74%。市场目前已完全计入12月至少加息25个基点的预期，美债遭抛售，两年期国债收益率大幅飙升。
vocab: phr. 计入价格，消化（预期）

title: Russia, Ukraine, U.S. conclude first day of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi
en: Russia, Ukraine and the United States concluded the first day of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi after nearly four hours of discussions, with the talks set to continue on Wednesday. It was the first such meeting among the three countries since February. The Russian delegation was headed by presidential aide Vladimir Medinsky, while US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner led the American team. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky described the talks as constructive and substantive, focusing on prisoner release, humanitarian steps and long-term security guarantees for Ukraine. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called the discussions very productive.
zh: 俄罗斯、乌克兰与美国在阿布扎比结束了首日三方会谈，磋商持续近4个小时，会谈将于周三继续。这是三方自今年2月以来首次举行此类会谈。俄方代表团由总统助理梅金斯基率领，美方特使威特科夫与库什纳率团参加。乌克兰总统泽连斯基称会谈富有建设性和实质意义，重点涉及释放被俘人员、人道主义举措以及乌克兰的长期安全保障。美国国务卿鲁比奥称会谈非常有成效。

title: Super El Nino to peak in December, WMO says
en: The World Meteorological Organization said 2026 could finish among the hottest years on record, as an exceptionally strong El Nino adds to human-caused global warming. The global average surface temperature from January to September was about 1.47 degrees Celsius above the pre-industrial average. The current El Nino has intensified since August and is forecast to peak in December, possibly reaching nearly four times the threshold for declaring such an event. Ocean heat is heading for a tenth consecutive annual record, and the global mean sea level has reached a new high. The report was released at the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Turkiye.
zh: 世界气象组织表示，在异常强劲的厄尔尼诺叠加人为全球变暖的背景下，2026年可能成为有记录以来最热的年份之一。今年1至9月，全球平均地表温度比工业化前平均水平高出约1.47摄氏度。本轮厄尔尼诺自8月以来持续增强，预计12月达到峰值，强度可能接近认定阈值的四倍。海洋热含量将连续第十年创下纪录，全球平均海平面也达到新高。该报告在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候大会期间发布。

title: Anthropic IPO expected to raise as much as $64.4 billion
en: Anthropic said its initial public offering is expected to raise as much as $64.4 billion, giving the AI company a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4 trillion. The firm plans to sell 825 million shares at 70 to 78 dollars each, with pricing expected on November 18 and trading to begin on the Nasdaq the following day. Anthropic also disclosed plans for a private placement of up to $26 billion involving strategic partners including Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC. The listing comes amid growing investor caution toward AI stocks, and analysts say it could force other AI heavyweights to compete harder for investor dollars.
zh: Anthropic表示，其首次公开募股预计最高融资644亿美元，这家AI公司的完全稀释估值最高可达1.4万亿美元。公司计划以每股70至78美元发行8.25亿股，预计11月18日定价、次日登陆纳斯达克。Anthropic还披露了规模最高260亿美元的私募配售计划，参与方包括谷歌、微软、英伟达和台积电等战略伙伴。此次上市正值投资者对AI股票日趋谨慎之际，分析师称这将迫使其他AI巨头更激烈地争夺投资人的资金。

title: Nvidia tumbles as shareholders sue CEO Jensen Huang
en: Nvidia shares fell more than 5% on Tuesday, bringing their two-day decline to about 10%, as investors weighed a shareholder lawsuit against the company and its chief executive, Jensen Huang. The suit, filed by a US law firm on behalf of investors, alleges that Nvidia and Huang failed to fully disclose his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman and the resulting reputational and business risks, constituting fraud. A report said the relationship facilitated the shipment of at least 7.5 billion dollars worth of Nvidia chips through Chinese firms. Several law firms have opened independent investigations into whether Nvidia misled investors.
zh: 英伟达股价周二下跌超过5%，两个交易日累计跌幅约10%，投资者正在权衡针对该公司及其首席执行官黄仁勋的股东诉讼。这起由美国一家律所代表投资人提起的诉讼指控称，英伟达与黄仁勋未充分披露其与一名中国女商人之间的关系及由此带来的声誉和经营风险，构成欺诈。有报道称，这层关系促成了至少价值75亿美元的英伟达芯片经中国公司出货。多家律所已就英伟达是否误导投资者展开独立调查。

title: OpenAI revenue jumps 50% to about $10 billion in Q3
en: OpenAI told investors that its third-quarter revenue grew about 50% from the previous quarter to roughly 10 billion dollars, implying an annualized rate of about 50 billion. Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar said growth was driven by frontier research and its enterprise business, which doubled quarter over quarter and now accounts for half of total revenue. The company also launched a test version of Businesses in ChatGPT, letting firms claim and manage their profiles, track user interactions and talk to potential customers through AI agents. The move directly challenges Google's dominance in commercial information search.
zh: OpenAI向投资者通报，第三季度营收环比增长约50%、达到约100亿美元，对应年化营收约500亿美元。首席财务官萨拉·弗里亚尔表示，增长由前沿研究和企业业务驱动，其中企业业务环比翻倍，目前已占总营收的一半。公司还推出了Businesses in ChatGPT测试版，企业可认领并管理自己的主页、追踪用户互动数据，并通过AI代理与潜在客户对话。此举直接挑战谷歌在商业信息检索领域的主导地位。
